description: Single alert policy shared by the Python replay (build_intelligence.py) and the Node decision engine (backend/src/services/decisionEngine.service.js). Thresholds follow CPCB AQI bands and the traffic/grid levels used across the dashboard.
message_template: {label} expected around {time} ({probability}% chance). Forecast {value}; likely range {low}-{high}. Main driver: {driver}. {action}

traffic_congestion.commuter: Leave 20-30 min earlier or later, or take Namma Metro.
traffic_congestion.outdoor_worker: Take breaks away from the carriageway during the peak.
traffic_congestion.general: Avoid non-essential road trips in this window.

grid_peak.general: Run washing machines, geysers and pumps outside this window.
grid_peak.elderly: Keep phones and medical devices charged in case of load-shedding.

compound_stress.commuter: Roads and the grid both peak now; travel off-peak if you can.
compound_stress.general: Shift heavy appliance use and road trips away from this window.

air_quality_sensitive.respiratory: Keep your inhaler handy and limit hard outdoor exercise.
air_quality_sensitive.child: Prefer indoor play; avoid roadside walks for children.
air_quality_sensitive.elderly: Limit long outdoor walks; rest indoors if breathing feels hard.
air_quality_sensitive.outdoor_worker: Wear an N95 mask and take breaks in cleaner air.

air_quality_poor.general: Reduce outdoor exertion; keep windows closed near busy roads.
air_quality_poor.respiratory: Stay indoors where possible and keep medication ready.
air_quality_poor.child: Keep children indoors; move outdoor school activities inside.
air_quality_poor.elderly: Stay indoors and seek care if breathing worsens.
air_quality_poor.outdoor_worker: Wear an N95 mask and cut heavy work during the peak.
air_quality_poor.commuter: Use a mask and keep car windows closed in traffic.

heat_stress.elderly: Drink water often and stay in a cool room in the afternoon.
heat_stress.child: Keep children shaded and hydrated; avoid midday play.
heat_stress.outdoor_worker: Shift heavy work to morning or evening; drink water hourly.
